ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Binaries and Scripts in Public Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a file with a suspicious extension in the public folder, which could indicate potential malicious activity.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.js$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$")))
